Beekie.text: Beekie is the most consistent shape in the book and the unluckiest: all four bets are 5-point, three-leg long-shot parlays built from a game total plus star points props, and all four lost for -20. Six of the eight props were on guards, overs and unders split evenly, and only 3 of 12 legs hit, with props going 2-6 and totals 1-3. The weekly boost went on a +608 parlay that missed. All four went in during one sitting about six hours before tip. The reads are not crazy, but needing three legs at once is the leak. Read: a game-script parlay builder who should try two legs.

Kev.text: Kev is the road-side single bettor of the group, and it is working: 3-0 for +43. All three bets were singles priced near even money on away teams, two spreads and a boosted moneyline, with Portland backed twice and both underdogs cashing. No parlays, props, totals or alt lines so far, and stakes stay modest at 10 to 20 points. He bets early, about seven and a half hours before tip, and has not copied Claude once. Nothing has gone wrong yet; the test is whether the dog reads hold over a bigger sample. Read: a disciplined road-dog side bettor.

Mio.text: Small sample, but a clear style: two bets, both two-leg parlays priced as favorites, both cashed for +52 on the biggest stakes in the group at 30 to 50 points. Three of the four legs were alt lines bought down to safer numbers, and the boost went on a -190 parlay. Read: a grinder who buys safety and presses the stake.

Sulliver.text: Sulliver is the Claude follower: four of his six settled bets copied Claude's pick, and the results are 1-5 for -26. He loves player-prop overs, seven of seven, with Shai backed twice, but those legs are 2-5 and his three alt legs are 0-3. He mixes four singles (1-3) with two three-leg parlays (0-2) at prices ranging from favorite to long shot, on 5 to 10 point stakes, usually about eight hours before tip. Spreads have gone 1-2. The overs instinct is fine; the long parlays and alt numbers are what bled. Read: no settled pattern of his own yet, a props-overs fan riding Claude.
